top_signals.title: Trump Curbs Farmers’ Access to Funding for Energy Projects
top_signals.summary: The Trump Administration is restricting access to a federal rural energy program for farmers in another move against renewable energy. But the major change to the Department of Agriculture’s Rural Energy for America Program (REAP) that eliminates upfront funding would make energy efficiency projects and cheaper energy for farmers inaccessible to many of them, analysts say. top_signals.title: Retail sales ‘sluggish’ as shoppers feel cautious ahead of Budget
top_signals.summary: British retail sales showed “sluggish” growth last month as shoppers became increasingly cautious ahead of the Autumn Budget.  Total sales at retailers increased by 1.3 per cent in the 12 months to September, compared to 2.3 per cent growth in September 2025, according to the British Retail Consortium (BRC) and Big Four giant KPMG. top_signals.title: Battersea Power Station nears completion with £280m new loan
top_signals.summary: The developers behind Battersea Power Station have secured a new £280m refinancing as the £5bn regeneration project nears its final stage.
